caption: The drawing features a rectangular layout with a broad border on the left and a narrower border along the top edge. The left border has a brownish background and is decorated with repeating green leaves and red-pink roses in a vertical row. The top border consists of a brown band with a scalloped red design and small floral details. The central portion is filled with a muted greenish-gray background. On this background is a symmetrical and ornate urn-like motif, outlined and decorated in red, black, and green, containing stylized foliage, flowers, and curving lines. Around the central motif, there are additional floral and leafy decorations in green and red with small black circles, arranged symmetrically along the sides and bottom. The composition uses earthy tones such as browns, greens, reds, and muted gold, and is marked by occasional white specks and cracks throughout.
title: Hand-Painted Wall
